description: Core ROSMAP AMS-AREA phenotype definitions. Missing phenotype values are excluded, never imputed. For AMS traits, Regular and Weighted encodings are required to select exactly the same samples.

traits.name: AD4_vs_NCI1
traits.description: Strict binary clinical diagnosis comparison: diagnosis 4 vs diagnosis 1.

traits.name: AD45_vs_NCI1
traits.description: Broader binary AD comparison: diagnosis 4/5 vs diagnosis 1.

traits.name: Cognitive_stage
traits.description: AMS cognitive progression model. Regular: cognitive impairment (MCI/AD) vs NCI. Weighted: NCI=0, MCI=0.5, AD=1. Other dementia (diagnosis 6) is excluded from both representations.

traits.name: Braak_stage
traits.description: AMS tangle-pathology model. Regular: Braak III-VI vs 0-II. Weighted: linear Braak burden from 0 to 1 across stages 0-6.

traits.name: CERAD_burden
traits.description: AMS amyloid-plaque model. CERAD coding is reversed so higher Weighted AREA values mean greater plaque burden. Regular: CERAD 1/2 vs 3/4. Weighted: 1->1, 2->2/3, 3->1/3, 4->0.
